title: Five Time NBA Champion Dennis Rodman Reveals He Was Violated & Disrespected By One Of His Ex-Wives & Former Teammate
htmlContent:
Dennis Rodman has the single most unpredictable personality in the NBA. While the five-time NBA champion was incredibly fierce and robust on the basketball field, he often wrestled with more minor things in his personal life. Rodman had many critical problems with his finances, his love life, and the destructive mentality which often troubled him.

The legend of the Chicago Bulls raged about his difficulties with marriage during the trailer of a last VH1 reality TV.

Dennis Rodman, along with seven other celebrities, including former WWE Superstar CJ Perry [Lana], are part of the cast of the VH1 reality show "The Surreal Life." According to the trailer, the first social reality experiment is finally back after 16 years. Rodman will undoubtedly be the focal point because unfiltered celebrities stay together in a mansion, leading to many dramatic moments.

In the recent trailer of "The Surreal Life", Rodman discusses his marital struggles. The Worm has always had trouble with relationships. He had a number of well-known girlfriends such as Carmen Electra and Madonna during his NBA days.

In the trailer, Rodman reveals, one of his wives had an extracurricular relationship with one of his teammates.

My teammate f*****my wife. I had to go and play a game that f***ing night,” Rodman shared.

The reality show will begin on October 24, with several episodes aired on VH1 at 9 p.m. ET.
